title: Carrington event solar storm

tellings.quote: Carrington event of 1859 so are you familiar with the solar storm of 1859 Carrington took out it would have taken out now the entire grid but it took out electrical lines

plain: In 1859 a huge solar storm, known as the Carrington event, knocked out electrical lines, and Michels says a storm like it today would take out the entire power grid. He brings it up himself in conversation with a guest, without naming a source, as a sign of how exposed modern life is to the sun.
